5.1 Frequently asked questions
5.1.1 What is MHA?Magic Hash (MHA) currently exists on BSC. Its total allocation is 10 billion. Planned roles in MAGNE-owned networks include gas, security staking and ecosystem incentives; migration terms require a separate announcement.5.1.2 Does MAGNE use a second governance token?The design references mBGT, but its retention and relationship to MHA voting rights remain to be confirmed. This draft neither declares a final single-token governance model nor announces a new token issuance.5.1.3 How fast is M Hash L2?Use dated measurements for the stated network and workload. Earlier 1-second and 2-second claims were not reconciled. Block inclusion, settlement finality and bridge withdrawal time are different metrics. Measurement guide5.1.4 Is a phone owner automatically a validator?No. Device tasks, validator admission and L2 ordering have separate rules. GEN1 eligibility does not grant block-production rights.5.1.5 What are the proposed validator requirements?The earlier proposal specified 250,000–10,000,000 MHA per validator, suitable server resources and availability checks. Admission, selection, penalties and the final consensus model require a confirmed technical specification before activation.5.1.6 Where do validator rewards come from?The 15% Staking Nodes allocation is separate from the 30% Mining Nodes allocation. Its earlier schedule releases half of that pool in year one and halves the annual amount thereafter. Eligibility and weighting must follow its own final rules. Staking allocation5.1.7 Does a phone receive 20,000 MHA in any 24 months?No. The illustration assumes participation from network M1, a fixed eligible population no greater than 13,750, full availability/effective work, and the standard base release schedule. Late entry and changing device counts change the result.5.1.8 What is PoL?Proof of Liquidity is a proposed way to coordinate eligible liquidity participation and reward allocation. It must not be treated as a complete consensus specification by itself. The deployed vault rules determine eligibility, release and claims.5.1.9 Do liquidity deposits automatically earn rewards?Not necessarily. Pool fees and additional vault incentives are separate. Vault admission, eligible receipt assets, funded budget and claim requirements must be checked for the actual deployment.5.1.10 What is a DEX or liquidity pool?A DEX uses smart contracts to support asset exchange. A liquidity pool holds assets under its contract rules; price impact depends on pool design, depth and trade size. Swap fees, network gas and slippage are different costs.5.1.11 How do APR and APY differ?APR is an annualised rate without compounding; APY includes an assumed compounding schedule. Neither is a guaranteed return. Fee income, incentives and asset-value changes must be distinguished.5.1.12 Can holders vote now?This draft does not establish a live governor. The voting asset, delegation method, contract and start date must be published before voting instructions apply. Governance proposal

4.3 建立與部署測試合約
範例採 Bash／WSL 指令、Node.js 24、Foundry 1.7.1、Solidity 0.8.30（Paris EVM 目標）及 OpenZeppelin Contracts 5.6.1，請使用下載中的固定版本及 lockfile。Paris 是範例相容性目標，不代表現行網絡分叉設定。下載完整合約範例4.3.1 本地編譯解壓縮後進入 contracts 資料夾並執行：npm install
npm run build
npm testsrc/Counter.sol// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity 0.8.30;
contract Counter {
    uint256 public number;
    function increment() external { number += 1; }
}
4.3.2 只在本地執行在一個終端啟動本地節點：npm run anvil在同一資料夾的第二個終端，使用 Anvil 已解鎖的開發帳戶部署。此步驟只發送至 localhost：npx forge create src/Counter.sol:Counter --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --unlocked --from 0xf39Fd6e51aad88F6F4ce6aB8827279cffFb92266 --broadcast4.3.3 選擇測試網# Select ONE network in Bash / WSL:
export MAGNE_RPC_URL="https://rpc.testnet.magicalhash.com"
export MAGNE_CHAIN_ID="20250810"
# For L2 instead:
# export MAGNE_RPC_URL="https://l2-rpc.testnet.magicalhash.com"
# export MAGNE_CHAIN_ID="20250827"
npx cast chain-id --rpc-url "$MAGNE_RPC_URL"確認回傳 Chain ID 與所選值相同；不符時停止。使用專用測試帳戶，向官方水龍頭取得測試 Gas。4.3.4 明確執行測試網部署以互動方式將測試帳戶匯入加密金鑰庫。帶 --broadcast 的指令會提交真正的測試網交易並使用測試 Gas；forge create 沒有該旗標時屬 dry run。不要把金鑰放在前端檔案或版本庫。npx cast wallet import magne-test --interactive
npx forge create src/Counter.sol:Counter --rpc-url "$MAGNE_RPC_URL" --account magne-test --broadcast
# Replace with the address printed after deployment:
export COUNTER_ADDRESS="0xYOUR_DEPLOYED_COUNTER_ADDRESS"
npx cast call "$COUNTER_ADDRESS" "number()(uint256)" --rpc-url "$MAGNE_RPC_URL"4.3.5 核對結果在所選測試網核對回執、Chain ID、已部署 bytecode 及初始計數值。命令範例不是部署證明。瀏覽器原始碼驗證取決於其支援的驗證器及 API，請按該瀏覽器指引操作，不使用虛構的鏈別名。Foundry deployment reference · 網絡配置
